Container markers define reproducible segments; they are not claimed to be manually verified frame-exact narrative starts. Dear27 includes an inserted performance image at2140s. Full chapter intervals include whatever the compilation contains.

Inherited Dear028–037 records below used interior windows identified by the supplied rebuild and are preserved as that generation. ## Audio component interpretation

| Component | Evidence / treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Misuzu dialogue | On-screen speaker/name supports visible scene identification at logged samples; no sample-level speaker track or voice isolation. |
| Other speakers | Temari/Rinha/Sena/Producer and others occur across compilations; chapter markers do not isolate one speaker. |
| BGM and inserted songs | Full first-audio-stream mix retained. Dear27 has visible performance material; no voiced/nonvoiced or BGM proportion asserted. |
| Effects / UI | May be mixed with dialogue; not separately detected or removed. |
| Silence | Only threshold-detected low-level intervals are tabulated; they cannot distinguish a conversational pause from music dropout or end padding. |
| Visual mattes / subtitles | Included in full-frame numerical samples. They can dominate brightness, saturation and image-difference values. |

## Inherited reproduction code for label-verified interior windows

Use the independently checked endpoints listed above; rerunning OCR is not required to reproduce the numeric measurements. This code also renders endpoint headers for visual review, but no resulting image is included in the delivery.

```python
from pathlib import Path
import json,cv2
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
import measure_media as m
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
id='1zZaheh3YRcrXMFCcWQIS-_Pxd32m3ChE';p=next((m.ROOT/'media/MISUZU'/id).glob('*.mp4'));d=json.loads((m.OUT/'MISUZU'/(id+'.json')).read_text())
windows=[(28,60,270),(29,330,570),(30,810,990),(31,1020,1440),(32,1470,1770),(33,1830,2130),(34,2190,2520),(35,2550,2730),(36,2760,3390),(37,3420,3810)]
cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(p));im=Image.new('RGB',(1000,4*125),'#eeeeee');dr=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
for i,(ch,a,b) in enumerate(windows):
 for j,t in enumerate([a,b]):
  cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC,t*1000);ok,fr=cap.read();crop=fr[:60,393:513];crop=cv2.cvtColor(cv2.resize(crop,(200,100)),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB);idx=2*i+j;x=idx%5*200;y=idx//5*125;im.paste(Image.fromarray(crop),(x,y));dr.text((x+3,y+104),f'{ch} check t={t}s',fill='black')
cap.release();im.save(m.ROOT/'frames/misuzu_late_window_headers.jpg')
def one(x):
 ch,a,b=x;tmp=m.ROOT/'measurements'/f'latewindow{ch}.wav';m.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-y','-i',str(p),'-map','0:a:0','-af',f'atrim=start={a}:end={b},asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS','-c:a','pcm_f32le',str(tmp)])
 r={'source_id':id,'input_sha256':d['sha256'],'label':f'Dear {ch} interior review window','chapter':ch,'start_s':a,'end_s':b,'duration_s':b-a,'boundary_method':'User-visible on-screen chapter number at both endpoints, selected from30s locator scan; exact sampling interval, not full chapter boundaries','audio_metrics':m.sound(tmp),'loudness':m.loudness(tmp),'visual':m.visual(p,a,b)};tmp.unlink();print(ch,flush=True);return r
if __name__=='__main__':
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as ex:rs=list(ex.map(one,windows))
 (m.OUT/'MISUZU_DEAR_LATE_WINDOWS.json').write_text(json.dumps(rs,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

```


Measurement-generation note: rows001–010/028–037 are fresh Windows measurements; rows011–027 retain the hash-matched incoming generation. No cross-generation pooled mean is reported. Full-frame brightness/image differences can change slightly with decoder version. Dear001 has zero P10 RMS; its floor-derived P90/P10 ratio is not meaningful dialogue dynamics.
